test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Compute the average of Sundar's scores across five subjects—English ( 99 marks), Mathematics ( 75 marks), Physics ( 52 marks), Chemistry ( 97 marks), and Biology ( 34 marks)—each evaluated out of a maximum of 100 .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume a base average of 70 and calculate deviations.

Deviations: (99−70) + (75−70) + (52−70) + (97−70) + (34−70)

Net Deviation = 29 + 5 − 18 + 27 − 36 = 7

Average Deviation = 7 ÷ 5 = 1.4

Actual Average = 70 + 1.4 = 71.4

**∴ The correct answer is 71.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks in five subjects: 99, 75, 52, 97, 34.

Total number of subjects = 5.

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dfc6ead8532c628fe8f21a841b9fffcbb43ca349096cc6ce90ba69343150a57.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of marks = 99 + 75 + 52 + 97 + 34

⇒ Sum of marks = 357

⇒ Average = 357 ÷ 5

⇒ Average = 71.4

**∴ The correct answer is 71.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when different observations have different weights. Formula: Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ...) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ...)

Average of Arithmetic Progression

For a series with a constant common difference, the average is simply (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.

Change in Average

If every observation is increased or decreased by a constant value k, the new average also increases or decreases by k.
